Our second-most long-serving member Ken O'Kell (68 years of membership) died at the age of 90 years on Christmas Day 1991. Until the year of his death he had remained very active and was still driving his motor-car.

Clive Shippen's article about the late Ken O'Kell, to be found elsewhere in this issue, mentions that Ken eventually joined the Club through the persuasive efforts of Bert Gordon and his father, Teddy, who was later to become President of Belgrave Harriers.
